en.title: Sterilisation log
en.summary: Every autoclave cycle at this branch, the instrument packs each made, and which pack was opened for which patient.

sections.heading: Recording a cycle
sections.body: When a load comes out, press Record a cycle. Choose the steriliser and what it was — a load of instruments, or the machine's Bowie–Dick or vacuum test. Give the time, the program and, if the display shows them, the temperature and minutes held. Read the indicator strip: pass if it changed colour. If a spore test went in, say so; it is read later. Write what the load held, one kind a line with the number first — "6 exam kit" — and each pack gets a code. Print the labels and stick one on each pouch.

sections.heading: At the chair
sections.body: When a pack is opened for a patient, press Packs used on a patient, find the patient, and type the code on the label (several at once is fine). A pack is used once. One from a failed cycle or past its use-by date is refused, by name.

sections.heading: Reading a spore test
sections.body: Open the cycle and press Spore test: no growth, or Spore test: growth. Growth fails the cycle: its unused packs are withdrawn, and the patients its packs were used on are listed at the top of the cycle with their phones, to be called. A reading cannot be changed.

sections.heading: Who can
sections.body: The log and every action need "sterilisation.record". Each branch sees its own log; a manager with every branch chosen sees all of them.

am.title: የመሣሪያ ማምከኛ መዝገብ
am.summary: በዚህ ቅርንጫፍ ያለ እያንዳንዱ የአውቶክሌቭ ዙር፣ የተሠሩት የመሣሪያ ፓኮች፣ እና የትኛው ፓክ ለየትኛው ታካሚ እንደተከፈተ።

sections.heading: ዙር መመዝገብ
sections.body: ጭነቱ ሲወጣ Record a cycle ይጫኑ። ማሽኑንና ዓይነቱን ይምረጡ፣ ሰዓቱን፣ ፕሮግራሙን፣ ሙቀቱንና ደቂቃዎቹን ይጻፉ። የአመልካች ወረቀቱን ያንብቡ፦ ቀለሙ ከተቀየረ pass። የስፖር ምርመራ ከገባ ይግለጹ፤ በኋላ ይነበባል። ጭነቱ የያዘውን በመስመር አንድ ዓይነት፣ ቁጥሩን አስቀድመው ይጻፉ — "6 exam kit"። እያንዳንዱ ፓክ ኮድ ያገኛል፤ መለያዎቹን አትመው በእያንዳንዱ ፓኬት ላይ ይለጥፉ።

sections.heading: በሕክምና ወንበሩ
sections.body: ፓክ ለታካሚ ሲከፈት Packs used on a patient ይጫኑ፣ ታካሚውን ይፈልጉ፣ በመለያው ላይ ያለውን ኮድ ይጻፉ። አንድ ፓክ አንድ ጊዜ ብቻ ይጠቀማል፤ ከወደቀ ዙር ወይም ጊዜው ያለፈበት ፓክ አይቀበልም።

sections.heading: የስፖር ምርመራ ማንበብ
sections.body: ዙሩን ይክፈቱና Spore test: no growth ወይም Spore test: growth ይጫኑ። ማደግ ዙሩን ያወድቃል፦ ያልተጠቀሙ ፓኮች ይወጣሉ፣ ፓኮቹ የተጠቀሙባቸው ታካሚዎች ከስልካቸው ጋር ለመደወል ይዘረዘራሉ።

sections.heading: ማን ይችላል
sections.body: መዝገቡና እያንዳንዱ ተግባር "sterilisation.record" ፈቃድ ያስፈልጋቸዋል። እያንዳንዱ ቅርንጫፍ የራሱን መዝገብ ያያል።
